name: Path of the Storm Herald
summary: A barbarian whose rage takes the form of a raging storm aura.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.short: While raging, a 10 ft. aura of desert, sea or tundra power.
features.summary: While raging you emanate a 10 ft. aura. Choose desert, sea or tundra; the aura's effect triggers when you rage and again as a bonus action on later turns. Its power grows at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level.

options.name: Desert
options.summary: Aura: each creature you choose takes 2 fire damage (scales with level).

grants.text: Storm Aura (Desert): Aura: each creature you choose takes 2 fire damage (scales with level).

options.name: Sea
options.summary: Aura: bonus action, one creature takes 1d6 lightning (DEX save for half; scales).

grants.text: Storm Aura (Sea): Aura: bonus action, one creature takes 1d6 lightning (DEX save for half; scales).

options.name: Tundra
options.summary: Aura: you and chosen creatures gain 2 temp HP (scales with level).

grants.text: Storm Aura (Tundra): Aura: you and chosen creatures gain 2 temp HP (scales with level).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.short: Resistance tied to your environment, plus a utility power.
features.summary: You gain resistance and a minor ability based on your chosen environment: desert (fire), sea (lightning, breathe underwater, 30 ft. swim) or tundra (cold).

grants.text: Storm Soul: resistance matching your Storm Aura environment (desert fire, sea lightning, tundra cold).

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.short: Allies in your aura share your storm resistance.
features.summary: Each creature of your choice has the damage resistance from your Storm Soul while it is in your Storm Aura.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.short: Your aura punishes, topples or roots enemies.
features.summary: Desert: reaction, a creature that hits you takes fire damage equal to half your level (DEX save). Sea: when you hit, knock the target prone (STR save). Tundra: when the aura activates, reduce one creature's speed to 0 (STR save).
